header: Problem 6 Precipitation-Dissolution Equilibria. Constants at 25 ℃ may be used. Report all calculated results to 3 significant figures and solubilities in mol/L: dissociation constants of $H_2S$, Ka_1 = 1.3×10^{-7}, Ka_2 = 7.1×10^{-15}; Ksp(MnS)=3.2×10^{-11}; Ksp($Mn(OH)_2$)=1.6×10^{-13}.

subquestions.text_open: 6.3 Accounting for the pH change, calculate the solubility of MnS in pure water.

6.4 Using the result from 6.3, demonstrate by calculation that $Mn(OH)_2$ precipitate actually forms in the system. Then calculate the solubility of MnS in pure water. Given Ksp($Mn(OH)_2$)=1.6×10^{-13}.
